confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Central area chief. The radio at 09:30 says scoop 2 (LH-02) is stopped at C564-08, but CMMS OT-5001 says it was closed 20 min ago and is operational. Confirm whether LH-02 is actually running. Until then nothing is moved for C564-08.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 broke down at C590-09 (hydraulic). The radio and CMMS agree: OT-5100 is repaired on site with a 3 / 4 / 5 h range, so it is back around 12:30–14:30. C590-09 is the best stope at 16.5 g/t, with 256 t of broken ore left and a short 80 m haul. The only loader free to cover it is LH-10, which sits idle in TALLER-564. Its preventive maintenance ends at 10:00, so it is not moved before then, which satisfies PM-01. The trip is about 0.4 h including the 0.25 h manoeuvre, so it arrives around 10:25. It mucks about 31 t/h at 80 m, so roughly 6.5 h × 31 ≈ 200 t, which is less than the 256 t available. Moving it costs nothing because it takes no producing place or development heading. Central is nearly truck-limited, with 4 trucks and a stockpile of 303 t out of 450 t. Because of that, the extra tonnes mostly raise the grade of the ore hauled rather than the tonnage. I estimate a gain of about 15 oz, and that figure is uncertain. For C564-08 the radio and CMMS disagree (CONFIRM-01), so I am not moving anything there and I am asking the area chief to confirm. I am not taking a loader from a producing stope or from DS-E569-02, which costs 5.7 oz/h. DS-E569-01 costs only 0.4 oz/h, but LH-08 would take about 1 h to travel and would add little in a truck-limited mine. No reserve is activated because no stope is stopped and confirmed.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
